# overall structure

Short film of the demo checkout form.

# voiceover

Friendly, upbeat.

# background music

no music

# steps

1. open `http://localhost:4705/checkout.html`
2. type `Demo Shopper` in the Full name box
3. type `demo@example.test` in the Email box
4. type `1 Test Street, Demo Town` in the Delivery address box
5. type `4242 4242 4242 4242` in the Card number box
6. type `12/30` in the Expiry box and `123` in the CVC box
7. click `Place demo order`
